title: Battle of Miranda
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Miranda", at revision 1370269486, opens: "The Battle of Miranda was the final battle of the Paraguayan War between Brazilian and Paraguayan soldiers from 4 to 8 April 1870 before the final organized Paraguayan force surrendered." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q106543381, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "último confronto da Guerra do Paraguai". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
